_comment: Local tenant store for pwsh/entra.ps1. install.sh copies this here on first
run and never touches it again, so it stays out of git.
tenants: managed by Add-EntraTenant / Remove-EntraTenant. Passwords are not
here; they live in the login keychain under service 'entra', keyed on the UPN.
apply: what `setenv` does in the repo you're standing in. Fill this in per
project — it is deliberately empty here so no project's variable names live
envScript  optional script, relative to the repo root, run before the
values below are applied (so these override it)
envFile    dotenv file to rewrite, relative to the repo root
env        NAME -> template, set as process environment variables
file       KEY  -> template, upserted into envFile
